item.tib: kun tu bzang po 'khor ba stong bar 'dren pa'i ngan song dong sprug gi rgyud las me la las bcol sbyin sreg 'bul thabs
item.coloph: de lta'i me mchod sbyin sreg 'bul thabs 'di/ lung bstan ji bzhin nges med rnal 'byor gyis/ bkod par byas la 'gal 'khrul byung srid na/ skyabs gnas mkhyen ldan spyan sngar mthol bshags phul/ dge mchis sgrub rgyud sangs rgyas bstan pa dar/ ma gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro drug sems can kun/ sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang / mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i rgyu gyur cig/
